segments.speaker: DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
segments.text: Good afternoon. The Department of the Interior and Local Government respectfully appears before the

segments.speaker: DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
segments.text: Honorable Committee to present our ?332.5 billion budget proposal for fiscal year 2027. Alongside

segments.speaker: DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
segments.text: priorities for the coming year we will highlight our major accomplishments and financial performance

segments.speaker: DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
segments.text: covering fiscal year 2025 to the first half of fiscal year 2026. We will also provide a

segments.speaker: DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
segments.text: detailed breakdown of the proposed allocation by expense class outlining the resources essential

segments.speaker: DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
segments.text: to implement priority programs and projects of the DILG and its attached agencies. Our achievements

segments.speaker: DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
segments.text: over the past two years reflect our steadfast commitment to building safer streets fostering

segments.speaker: DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
segments.text: progressive communities and empowering good local governance nationwide every single peso entrusted

segments.speaker: DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
segments.text: to us will be matched with decisive action and tangible public service that will reach every

segments.speaker: DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
segments.text: filipino working hand in hand across all branches of the government from the national level to the

segments.speaker: DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
segments.text: heart of every barangay across the country with permission of the chair will we now present the

segments.speaker: DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
segments.text: audiovisual presentation of the DILG's fiscal year 2027 budget proposal.

segments.speaker: DILG Video Narrator
segments.text: The Department of the Interior and Local Government is at the forefront of

segments.speaker: DILG Video Narrator
segments.text: advancing peace and order, public safety,

segments.speaker: DILG Video Narrator
segments.text: together with its attached agencies the department works to strengthen local government units

segments.speaker: DILG Video Narrator
segments.text: enhance public safety and emergency response and promote inclusive programs that uplift the lives

segments.speaker: DILG Video Narrator
segments.text: entrusted to us by Congress, the Department has continued to fulfill its mandate and deliver

segments.speaker: DILG Video Narrator
segments.text: programs aligned with the President's priorities for the country. Safeguarding our collective peace

segments.speaker: DILG Video Narrator
segments.text: and prosperity and ensuring our people safe and secure remained among our foremost priorities.

segments.speaker: DILG Video Narrator
segments.text: We continue to strengthen the unified 9-1-1 system through acquiring additional assets

segments.speaker: DILG Video Narrator
segments.text: and expanding access to emergency services, which led to more calls, fewer prank calls,

segments.speaker: DILG Video Narrator
segments.text: and an improved emergency response time. The aggressive anti-criminality campaign by the PNP

segments.speaker: DILG Video Narrator
segments.text: led to reduced crimes throughout the country, while the NAPLCOM fulfilled its commitment of

segments.speaker: DILG Video Narrator
segments.text: zero backlog in cases involving police officers that helped restore accountability, integrity,

segments.speaker: DILG Video Narrator
segments.text: Our unrelenting drive against illegal drugs led to billions worth of drugs seized,

segments.speaker: DILG Video Narrator
segments.text: thousands arrested, and more barangays nationwide cleared of drug-related threats.

segments.speaker: DILG Video Narrator
segments.text: This we did even as we completed development projects in conflict-affected areas

segments.speaker: DILG Video Narrator
segments.text: and gave former rebels more opportunities to begin anew.

segments.speaker: DILG Video Narrator
segments.text: we significantly reduced jail congestion as well as provided holistic rehabilitation

segments.speaker: DILG Video Narrator
segments.text: and reintegration services for persons deprived of liberty.

segments.speaker: DILG Video Narrator
segments.text: We instituted sweeping reforms within the BFP to strengthen transparency, integrity,

segments.speaker: DILG Video Narrator
segments.text: and accountability, which contributed to more effective and efficient fire prevention

segments.speaker: DILG Video Narrator
segments.text: and suppression services, thereby reducing fire incidents,

segments.speaker: DILG Video Narrator
segments.text: The Department continues to empower and transform our local government units

segments.speaker: DILG Video Narrator
segments.text: as capable and agile partners for national development.

segments.speaker: DILG Video Narrator
segments.text: Our rigorous monitoring of national and local government-funded projects

segments.speaker: DILG Video Narrator
segments.text: ensured the completion of thousands of projects such as farm-to-market roads, evacuation centers,

segments.speaker: DILG Video Narrator
segments.text: and other community facilities that benefited millions of Filipino families,

segments.speaker: DILG Video Narrator
segments.text: especially in underserved and disadvantaged areas.

segments.speaker: DILG Video Narrator
segments.text: We nurtured our newly elected local officials,

segments.speaker: DILG Video Narrator
segments.text: as well as our barangay and sangguniang kabataan officials

segments.speaker: DILG Video Narrator
segments.text: We accelerated the digitalization and automation of LGU services

segments.speaker: DILG Video Narrator
segments.text: that led to faster and more efficient governance,

segments.speaker: DILG Video Narrator
segments.text: which is essential in attracting businesses and investments

segments.speaker: DILG Video Narrator
segments.text: and boosting economic development among LGUs.

segments.speaker: DILG Video Narrator
segments.text: The department likewise played a pivotal role in making our LGUs adequately prepared,

segments.speaker: DILG Video Narrator
segments.text: which cushioned the impact of typhoons and other calamities

segments.speaker: DILG Video Narrator
segments.text: that hit the various parts of the country.

segments.speaker: DILG Video Narrator
segments.text: These include the constant monitoring of evacuations,

segments.speaker: DILG Video Narrator
segments.text: as well as the timely and strategic deployment of first responders in affected areas

segments.speaker: DILG Video Narrator
segments.text: to provide immediate assistance during and after disasters.

segments.speaker: DILG Video Narrator
segments.text: We also monitored the completion of rehabilitated and constructed facilities

segments.speaker: DILG Video Narrator
segments.text: and maintained the cleanliness of barangays and communities

segments.speaker: DILG Video Narrator
segments.text: to help prevent further risks to public health.

segments.speaker: DILG Video Narrator
segments.text: Uplifting the lives and welfare of every Filipino

segments.speaker: DILG Video Narrator
segments.text: has been the driving force behind our sectoral interventions.

segments.speaker: DILG Video Narrator
segments.text: We advanced the institutionalization of early childhood care and development

segments.speaker: DILG Video Narrator
segments.text: while investing in the capacity and potential of the next generation of Filipinos.

segments.speaker: DILG Video Narrator
segments.text: We also continued to address the needs of our Muslim brethren

segments.speaker: DILG Video Narrator
segments.text: while strengthening our efforts in advancing gender equality in the country

segments.speaker: DILG Video Narrator
segments.text: that are at par with or even better than those of others.

segments.speaker: DILG Video Narrator
segments.text: In addition, we have been working with other countries in Asia and across the globe.

segments.speaker: DILG Video Narrator
segments.text: These and much more have been made possible

segments.speaker: DILG Video Narrator
segments.text: as reflected in our strong financial performance in 2025

segments.speaker: DILG Video Narrator
segments.text: with a 96% obligation rate and a 95% disbursement rate.

segments.speaker: DILG Video Narrator
segments.text: Similarly, we remain on track to achieve our financial targets for the year

segments.speaker: DILG Video Narrator
segments.text: with a 55% obligation rate and a

segments.speaker: DILG Video Narrator
segments.text: nearly 97% disbursement rate as of mid-year.

segments.speaker: DILG Video Narrator
segments.text: Our proposal for the next fiscal year reflects our commitment to sustaining our ongoing initiatives

segments.speaker: DILG Video Narrator
segments.text: and advancing our goals, amounting to a total of P332.5 billion, a 7% increase from last

segments.speaker: DILG Video Narrator
segments.text: Of this amount, Bureau of Jail Management and Penology, Bureau of Fire Protection, Philippine

segments.speaker: DILG Video Narrator
segments.text: National Police, and the Office of the Secretary have registered increases in their respective

segments.speaker: DILG Video Narrator
segments.text: While the Early Childhood Care and Development Council, Philippine Commission on Women, National

segments.speaker: DILG Video Narrator
segments.text: Commission on Muslim Filipinos, National Youth Commission, and National Police Commission

segments.speaker: DILG Video Narrator
segments.text: Consistent with the previous years, the majority of our proposed budget, equivalent to 84%,

segments.speaker: DILG Video Narrator
segments.text: is allocated to personal services, while 13% is earmarked for maintenance and other operating

segments.speaker: DILG Video Narrator
segments.text: The proposed budget is broken down by

segments.speaker: DILG Video Narrator
segments.text: With your help, we will be able to build on these gains through the proposals each agency

segments.speaker: DILG Video Narrator
segments.text: has put forward for your consideration.

segments.speaker: DILG Video Narrator
segments.text: The Office of the Secretary will continue to uplift local governance in every community

segments.speaker: DILG Video Narrator
segments.text: through the implementation of various programs and projects that strengthen LGU capacity,

segments.speaker: DILG Video Narrator
segments.text: hasten implementation of development programs, advance digitalization, and improve the quality

segments.speaker: DILG Video Narrator
segments.text: while strengthening the fight against illegal drugs and advancing peace and order in the communities.

segments.speaker: DILG Video Narrator
segments.text: Our drive continues to focus on the rehabilitation and cleanup of Manila

segments.speaker: DILG Video Narrator
segments.text: and preparedness, enhancing the department's ICT capabilities, and fully operationalizing

segments.speaker: DILG Video Narrator
segments.text: our new central office and regional offices. The LGA will continue to strengthen LGUs and

segments.speaker: DILG Video Narrator
segments.text: the DILG personnel through training newly elected barangay officials, advancing disaster readiness,

segments.speaker: DILG Video Narrator
segments.text: innovation, creative industries, and security, and strengthening their capacity to deliver these

segments.speaker: DILG Video Narrator
segments.text: interventions. To uphold integrity and trust in our police force, the NAPOLCOM will prioritize

segments.speaker: DILG Video Narrator
segments.text: investments in critical facilities in Regions 3, 5, and Cordillera Administrative Region,

segments.speaker: DILG Video Narrator
segments.text: ICT projects, ISO certification, and equipment for Negros Island Region.

segments.speaker: DILG Video Narrator
segments.text: The Philippine National Police will strengthen its ranks to become a reliable and trustworthy

segments.speaker: DILG Video Narrator
segments.text: partner in law enforcement through the recruitment of new personnel, enhanced equipment and ICT

segments.speaker: DILG Video Narrator
segments.text: capabilities, and stronger support for the welfare of its personnel. This will also include

segments.speaker: DILG Video Narrator
segments.text: fulfilling commitments under the Program Convergence Initiatives, intensifying police

segments.speaker: DILG Video Narrator
segments.text: The Bureau of Fire Protection will likewise accelerate efforts in fire prevention,

segments.text: suppression, and emergency response through hiring new fire officers, operationalizing newly

segments.speaker: DILG Video Narrator
segments.text: completed fire stations, deploying new fire trucks, procuring equipment, and constructing

segments.speaker: DILG Video Narrator
segments.text: new fire stations, training centers, and a fire arson laboratory. To safeguard and rehabilitate

segments.speaker: DILG Video Narrator

segments.speaker: DILG Video Narrator
segments.text: It will also counter illegal drugs in our jails, procure new firearms, radios, and vans,

segments.text: and construct new jail facilities in Calabarzon, molding the minds of our future public order

segments.text: and procurement of PPEs and ICT equipment. The National Youth Commission will lead the

segments.speaker: DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
segments.text: But it is a state policy, and I agree with the state policy, that EJKs are no longer allowed.

segments.speaker: DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
segments.text: But knowing who these recalcitrant people are, and knowing that they're in possession of illegal firearms,

segments.speaker: DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
segments.text: it would greatly help us in curbing criminality if we can arrest them and hold them without bail

segments.speaker: DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
segments.text: We estimate that these are 2 million at the high level, 1 million at the low level of illegal loose firearms on the roads, in the communities.

segments.speaker: DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
segments.text: We estimate that there are 42,000 barangays. If we arrest 2 per barangay, that's 84,000.

segments.speaker: DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
segments.text: But we estimate we will, if given that chance, we will arrest maybe up to 150,000 more criminals and take them off the streets.

segments.speaker: Senator Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: Ito'y nagpapalakas ng loob ng mga criminals.

segments.speaker: DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
segments.text: Yes, sir. Kasi madala, sir, pag-bail, one week later, they'll commit another crime using another firearm. Marami silang taguan.

segments.speaker: Senator Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: And how can we amend the law or repeal, if that matter, kung kailangan, in order to stop this, itong paikot-ikot na lang na criminality?

segments.speaker: DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
segments.text: Yes, sir. We have to repeal that law, sir, that was passed in 1995, if I believe.

segments.speaker: DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
segments.text: I think it was 1995 when illegal firearms became bailable. So we are asking that that law be repealed and make it non-bailable again.

segments.speaker: Senator Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: So hindi na sila natatakot? Ibig sabihin mayroon siyang loose firearms? Alam naman nila makakabail sila.

segments.speaker: DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
Senator Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: Pag-bail nila, balik ulit sa ano?

segments.speaker: DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
Senator Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: Saan nila binibili itong mga loose firearms?

segments.speaker: DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
segments.text: San-san na lang, sir. May meron ang galing yung home industries na ginagawa dito sa Pilipinas.

segments.speaker: DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
segments.text: Mayroon din yung mga lagi-import illegally through some portal zones of our coastlines.

segments.speaker: DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
segments.text: But safe to say, sir, that if there are 2 million firearms on the loose right now, and 98% of the crimes are committed with these,

segments.speaker: DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
segments.text: then we will grant an amnesty and determine whether these firearms were used in the commission of crimes.

segments.speaker: DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
segments.text: But otherwise, sir, this repealment will greatly aid our nation.

segments.speaker: Senator Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: In terms of itong mga petty drugs, ako naririnig rin, naririnig ko rin sa mga punong barangay namin sa Valenzuela,

segments.text: na itong madaming petty drug dealings on the ground.

segments.speaker: DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
segments.text: In the last year, we have interdicted almost 11 tons, I think, of...

segments.speaker: DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
segments.text: or in 2 years, we've interdicted 11 tons of shabu, pure shabu, from the market.

segments.speaker: DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
segments.text: That drove up the price of shabu, but now what they're doing is lowering the purity again to maybe 5 to 8%.

segments.speaker: DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
segments.text: We find that the biggest consumers are in the transport sector, which we have to address also.

segments.text: And a lot of them are true-want miners also, who roam the streets.

segments.speaker: DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
segments.text: Sir, we find that if it were part of our wish list, we would like to reform the concept of region,

segments.speaker: DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
segments.text: Region 4B, and revise the entire system as it is.

segments.speaker: DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
segments.text: As it is, Sir, Region 4B, its base is in Calapan, Negro Eye, and Mindoro.

segments.speaker: DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
segments.text: But if you go there, none of the state offices are located in Calapan.

segments.speaker: DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
segments.text: Like, even the ALG 4B, their main office is located in Quezon City.

segments.speaker: DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
segments.text: The SWD is not there also.

segments.speaker: DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
segments.text: Sir, what we propose is that we break up region, we bring it back to Region 4 into one region,

segments.speaker: DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
segments.text: but divide it into different command centers.

segments.speaker: DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
segments.text: What we would propose is that Cavite and Palawan be one region, one sub-region,

segments.speaker: DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
segments.text: Batangas and Mindoro, one region, Laguna and Rizal, one region,

segments.speaker: DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
segments.text: and then Quezon and Marinduque and Rumblon.

segments.speaker: DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
segments.text: They will all be one region.

segments.speaker: DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
segments.text: In that way, Sir, the government functions will be more rationalized.

segments.speaker: DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
segments.text: As of now, Sir, it's almost impossible to be command or to be regional director of any agency to be in 4B.

segments.speaker: DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
segments.text: And no one is in Calapan, except for the PNP.

segments.speaker: DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
segments.text: But outside that, even agriculture, you were once part of the SWD, they're here in Manila.

segments.speaker: DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
segments.text: So I suggest that we break up that region to make it more responsive to the times.

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin Tulfo
segments.text: So when do you plan to do that?

segments.speaker: DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
segments.text: We will propose it to the Senate this coming, this year, Sir, and hopefully it will be supported.

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin Tulfo
segments.text: Another thing, Sec, yung ating pong PNP Maritime, kailangan po nila ng mga fast craft, lalo po sa Palawan,

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin Tulfo
segments.text: because I came from Palawan, panghabol po sa mga illegal fishermen.

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin Tulfo
segments.text: Ilang po mga members, yung sasakyan po ng maritime, minsan hindi na po gumagana, problema po, pyesa.

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin Tulfo
segments.text: Yung iba naman, gumagawa ng paraan, sumasakay po sa pump boat.

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin Tulfo
segments.text: E hindi sila makahabol po sa mga illegal fishermen, mga basnig, mga twin engine pa.

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin Tulfo
segments.text: So what do you plan to do this?

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin Tulfo
segments.text: Are you going to procure more sea transport for our faster vehicle or sea vessel for our PNP Maritime?

segments.speaker: DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
segments.text: Our strategy is the rationalization of the Philippine Coast Guard at the maritime.

segments.speaker: DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
segments.text: We believe that the Philippine Coast Guard, which is currently under the DOTR, should be under the DILG.

segments.speaker: DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
segments.text: If the Coast Guard is under the DILG, because they are in charge of law enforcement in the seas,

segments.speaker: DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
segments.text: then we can abrogate the entire maritime command of the PNP and have the Coast Guard be in charge of enforcement.

segments.speaker: DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
segments.text: We would also like to suggest that the BGNP be transferred to the Bureau of Corrections

segments.speaker: DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
segments.text: so that we will only have one correctional institution instead of two.

segments.speaker: DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
segments.text: Ibang BGNP, ibang BUCOR, dapat isa na lang yan, Sir.

segments.speaker: DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
segments.text: So those are the things that we think we should do to rationalize the system of law enforcement in the country.

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin Tulfo
segments.text: Already a bill on that matter, Sir, this year to transfer the BGNP to the Bureau of Corrections.

segments.speaker: DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
segments.text: It would also help, Sir, if the Philippine Coast Guard were transferred to the DILG

segments.speaker: DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
segments.text: so that the law enforcement would all be under one department.

segments.speaker: DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
segments.text: Sir, another aspect, Sir, is that we are the only country in the ASEAN that the Bureau of Immigration is under the Department of Justice.

segments.speaker: DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
segments.text: Not under the Department of the Interior.

segments.speaker: DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
segments.text: As of now, Sir, when we go after foreign nationals, we have to go to the, the process is very cumbersome.

segments.speaker: DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
segments.text: We have to go to the Bureau of Immigration, who has to go to the Department of Justice,

segments.speaker: DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
segments.text: who will then give authorization to the Bureau of Immigration, who will then go back to the PNP.

segments.speaker: DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
segments.text: So our response time for fugitives or for foreigners is more difficult.

segments.speaker: DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
segments.text: So those are the rationalizations we propose, Sir.

segments.text: Have you recommended to the President?

segments.text: One last question po, Secretary John Vic.

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin Tulfo
segments.text: Ilalapit ko na rin po sa inyo, tutal eh, mahilig po kayong baguhin at ayusin po yung sistema.

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin Tulfo
segments.text: Kaya nga po, eh, natutuwa ako.

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin Tulfo
segments.text: Ilalapit ko lang po sa inyo ito.

segments.text: Pero ang problema po kasi parang matagal pong sumagot.

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin Tulfo
segments.text: Namatay daw yung tatay niya kasi tunghawin sa 911, 10 minutes bago sumagot po.

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin Tulfo
segments.text: At nung sumag pa, hinold po po siya.

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin Tulfo
segments.text: Can you look into this, Sec?

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin Tulfo
segments.text: I know you have the, may political will ho kayo at kaya niyong baguhin ito mga,

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin Tulfo
segments.text: at risolbahin naman kayo itong klaseng problema.

segments.speaker: DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
segments.text: Sir, I have the report here on hand.

segments.speaker: DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
segments.text: I can submit it or I can read it.

segments.speaker: DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
segments.text: Sir, the call was answered at approximately 12.15pm.

segments.speaker: DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
segments.text: That was a waiting time of 1 minute and 25 seconds.

segments.speaker: DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
segments.text: The biggest problem that we had there, sir, was that he gave a,

segments.speaker: DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
segments.text: the address that he gave was a block number and street number and house number.

segments.speaker: DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
segments.text: Where in Taguig, red has names of streets.

segments.speaker: DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
segments.text: So, when we called the Taguig to, Taguig police or BFP to respond,

segments.text: they couldn't find the address because there is no longer an address,

segments.speaker: DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
segments.text: a record of where that block and street number was.

segments.speaker: DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
segments.text: Eventually, they found it, but the barangay had reported ahead.

segments.speaker: DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
segments.text: So, there was a communication gap and we have addressed that

segments.speaker: DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
segments.text: and we are strengthening our response time.

segments.speaker: DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
segments.text: But that was a fluke, sir.

segments.speaker: DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
segments.text: That was one call that was...

segments.speaker: DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
segments.text: that we have learned from and we are improving with.

segments.text: May plano po ba ang PNP na mag-augment pa po ng air assets para mas mabilis?

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin Tulfo
segments.text: Given the situation, lalo na po sa Metro Manila na sobrang traffic,

segments.text: mas mabilis po ang mobility kung meron pong air assets

DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla

segments.speaker: DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla

segments.speaker: DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
segments.text: The drones that we are purchasing, sir, can fly for 7 hours

segments.speaker: DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
segments.text: at only a cost of 5,000 pesos per hour of use.

segments.speaker: DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
segments.text: So, we are procuring, I think, 10 drones to patrol the entire country.

segments.speaker: DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
segments.text: And I think it will be equipped with the latest infrared cameras,

segments.speaker: DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
segments.text: and telescopes that can locate and help and augment in the peacekeeping.

segments.speaker: DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
segments.text: So, if we call 911, we have an air asset on the sky,

segments.speaker: DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
segments.text: and it can go immediately on top of the crime scene and give a report on what is going on.

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin Tulfo
segments.text: Secretary, please continue po yung ginagawa ninyo mga changes sa inyo pong departamento and attach agency.

segments.speaker: Senator Erwin Tulfo
segments.text: You are doing a good job. Thank you, Secretary.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: Siguro, with regards to that, sir, we will support you.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: Yung acquisition of drones, that's more practical for surveillance and monitoring.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: But I think yung pong sa, Mr. Chair, yung pong sa, with the use of the helicopters,

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: I think, suggestion nyo natin is to disperse it to the different regions

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: so that yung presence will be there.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: Kasi there, I still feel, think that there are still functions,

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: tsaka pag-rescue mismo, lalo na calamity prone.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: So we have allocated budget for construction of hangars in Cebu, Davao,

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: and probably you can add more so that ma-deploy na sila.

segments.text: So I think it will be used for police.

DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
segments.text: I also recommend a change of model, sir, from the Airbus to the MC-10, I think, or MC-11,

segments.speaker: DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
segments.text: the model, because as of current,

segments.speaker: DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
segments.text: the ones that we have are personal transport vehicles.

segments.text: and we will distribute it around the country if we were given the budget to do so.

segments.text: And I agree with Senator J.V. Sec.

segments.text: Whereas kung meron nga po, lalapit po sila sa PNP, tatawag, mas mabilis po yung deployment.

segments.speaker: DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
segments.text: And so we have to have a restudy on the core competency of the PNP in maintaining and operating helicopters.

segments.speaker: DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
segments.text: because it might end up in bigger problems if we put unqualified personnel into the PNP.

segments.speaker: Senator Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: I do agree. Dahil baka yung iba rin, iba yung motivation.

segments.text: Alam naman natin na yung pagiging polis mabigat.

segments.speaker: Senator Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: Pero baka iba, short term lang yung tinitignan nila.

segments.speaker: Senator Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: Yung mga, alam na natin, mga racket ang tinitignan nila.

segments.speaker: Senator Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: So, I agree. I agree that we need to also be very careful in the recruitment of our policemen.

segments.text: We find, sir, that we made a study of the 8,000 dismissed PNP police persons ages 55 and below.

segments.text: Dahil alam nyo naman, dahil former governor kayo, na ang nagpapasweldo ng daycare teachers, mga LGUs,

segments.speaker: Senator Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: ang nagbabayad ng kuryente ng mga daycare, mga LGUs.

segments.speaker: Senator Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: So, that's why we transferred it to the DALG para ma-push yung mga LGUs to take ECCD seriously.

segments.speaker: Senator Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: And we thank the department for issuing the IRR last August 5.

segments.speaker: Senator Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: But on the ground, Secretary, and I'm just putting this on the table, just to flag the department,

segments.speaker: Senator Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: na hindi pa lahat ng LGUs ay nabibigyan ng instructions, maybe through a memorandum circular or a DALG circular,

segments.speaker: Senator Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: to operationalize the law on the ground.

segments.speaker: Senator Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: I'll give you a case in point.

segments.speaker: Senator Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: Under the law, kasi he has to create a separate office for early childhood care.

segments.speaker: Senator Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: Of course, yung mga plantelia items rin, for child development workers, child development teachers, hindi pa rin nakakreate.

segments.speaker: Senator Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: So, I just want to flag the department.

segments.speaker: Senator Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: Nandiyan na yung IRR, but to mobilize the LGUs, yun na lang ang nagkukulang.

segments.speaker: DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
segments.text: And we will exert all efforts to complete it, sir.

segments.speaker: Senator Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: Next year, I noted also that the target is quite ambitious.

segments.speaker: Senator Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: Right now, ang ating participation rate na sa 33%.

segments.speaker: Senator Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: So, I support that, of course.

segments.speaker: Senator Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: The more mga bata, 3-4 year olds pumapasok, the better.

segments.speaker: Senator Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: That's why it's about time to mobilize the LGUs.

segments.speaker: Senator Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: And I think, being a former governor, alin yun naman kung paano mag-mobilize ng mga LGUs.

segments.speaker: DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
segments.text: A large part of that is the feeding program that you will have for the children.

segments.speaker: DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
segments.text: We will get a meals ready to eat.

segments.speaker: DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
segments.text: Parang yung nutriban dati nung time ng Amerikano at time ng matandang Marcos.

segments.speaker: DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
segments.text: But the meals will be pre-packed and just heated in the respective barangays.

segments.speaker: DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
segments.text: We find that a more efficient system than giving the money to the LGUs to cook for the children.

segments.speaker: DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
segments.text: Because the variance of cost in the mountains and in the cities are different.

segments.speaker: DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
segments.text: This company to make meals ready to eat packets that just need to be heated.

segments.speaker: DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
segments.text: Then the nutritional value will be more efficiently distributed to the children at a lower cost than to cook it manually over the 42,000 marangays in the country.

segments.speaker: Senator Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: It's also part of the ECCD law.

segments.speaker: Senator Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: So, ang kulang lang, Secretary, is a memorandum circular to all the LGUs on implementing the law and also operationalizing the law on the ground.

segments.speaker: Senator Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: I think makikita natin malaking pagbabago na sa delivery ng early childhood education.

segments.speaker: DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
segments.text: I agree, sir. We will have an MCA regarding this.

segments.speaker: Senator Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: And lastly, Mr. Chairman, medyo nagugulat lang ako dun sa mga naririnig ko about BFP.

segments.speaker: Senator Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: Dati, ang naririnig lang natin, nagbebenta ng fire extinguisher.

segments.speaker: Senator Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: Kanina, nabanggit nyo yung bid rigging.

segments.speaker: Senator Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: And I'm very concerned with that.

segments.speaker: Senator Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: And that's why when you shaked up the BFP, the department, talagang kailangan na talaga.

segments.speaker: Senator Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: And I can see that we have a new chief, a new leader.

segments.speaker: Senator Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: Nakatrabaho ko po si fire chief sa...

segments.speaker: Senator Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: Not me, but si Secretary Rex when he was a mayor.

segments.speaker: Senator Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: So, nakita ko na he was a very effective fire chief when he was in Valenzuela.

segments.speaker: Senator Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: So, I hope, Fire Chief Kwan Tiu, matigil na itong mga corrupt practices in the department.

segments.speaker: Senator Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: Nakakagulat eh, nung I heard earlier, na all the way to bid rigging and slot selling, hindi na maganda.

segments.speaker: Senator Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: So, I hope that massive reforms will be undertaken in order to clean up the BFP.

segments.speaker: DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
segments.text: Sir, we already had a purge of the top leadership.

segments.speaker: DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
segments.text: And just this morning, I met with all the fire marshals of NCR and Region 4 where our major economic hubs are.

segments.speaker: DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
segments.text: And I warned them in no uncertain terms that if I catch them or if they are involved in any shenanigans,

segments.speaker: DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
segments.text: I will not hesitate to file charges against them.

segments.speaker: DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
segments.text: I told them, I am not part of the system, I have never been part of the system, and I will destroy the system.

segments.speaker: DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
segments.text: So, it is a very stern warning I gave to the...

segments.speaker: DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
segments.text: And we will follow up and make sure that they comply.

segments.speaker: DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
Senator Panfilo Lacson
segments.text: One of my advocacies, pagka-budget ng pigusapan, and this is one of your mandates,

segments.speaker: Senator Panfilo Lacson
segments.text: is to ensure the alignment of LGU plans with the national priorities.

segments.speaker: Senator Panfilo Lacson
segments.text: In fact, may budget po ito eh, 206 million pesos sa 2027.

segments.speaker: Senator Panfilo Lacson
segments.text: Yun yung support for local governance program.

segments.speaker: Senator Panfilo Lacson
segments.text: Kasi yung pre-mandanas, ang share ng local government, yung RDC-endorsed PAPs,

segments.speaker: Senator Panfilo Lacson
segments.text: Ito lagi kong pinapoint out every time meron kaming plenary deliberation, especially sa DBCC.

segments.speaker: Senator Panfilo Lacson
segments.text: Ang core dapat ng budgeting system natin, sa labas eh, di ba?

segments.speaker: Senator Panfilo Lacson
segments.text: Now it has improved to something like 35%, pero kulang pa rin.

segments.speaker: Senator Panfilo Lacson
segments.text: Kasi yung first, yung synchronization ng preparation of the local government plans,

segments.speaker: Senator Panfilo Lacson
segments.text: ng mga local government councils, hindi ito in sync with the budget call, yung timing.

segments.speaker: Senator Panfilo Lacson
segments.text: Nagbabudget call tayo, yung start ng process siguro mga January, February.

segments.speaker: Senator Panfilo Lacson
segments.text: Pero halos October na, hindi pa tapos yung deliberation sa mga local development councils.

segments.speaker: Senator Panfilo Lacson
segments.text: how do we, at least, you know,

segments.speaker: Senator Panfilo Lacson
segments.text: para tumaas yung percentage ng RDC-endorsed PAPs

segments.speaker: Senator Panfilo Lacson
segments.text: doon sa pag-craft ng national budget?

segments.speaker: DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
segments.text: Sir, the RDC, for the longest time, kasi hindi na pinapansin yung RDC eh.

segments.speaker: DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
segments.text: It is only under the administration of the current president

segments.speaker: DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
segments.text: that the RDCs have been given more attention to

segments.speaker: DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
segments.text: The biggest hindrance to that, sir,

segments.speaker: DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
segments.text: is that it becomes a political question in its implementation.

segments.speaker: DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
segments.text: When we, when the RDCs, the local development,

segments.speaker: DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
segments.text: when the regional development councils endorse a project,

segments.speaker: DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
segments.text: it becomes a political question on the legislature

segments.speaker: DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
segments.text: whether or not they will put money into the project that has been endorsed.

segments.speaker: DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
segments.text: even upon the insistence of the DILG,

segments.speaker: DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
segments.text: they follow it in the legislature,

segments.speaker: DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
segments.text: somehow in the budget processing system,

segments.speaker: DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
segments.text: nawawala po yung priorities na yan.

segments.speaker: DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
segments.text: So, if only the congressmen can be part of the RDCs,

segments.speaker: DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
segments.text: so they will realize how important it is that these projects be done,

segments.speaker: DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
segments.text: then maybe they will be in sync with how it is accomplished.

segments.speaker: DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
segments.text: the congressmen are not part of the RDCs,

segments.speaker: DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
segments.text: and senators should be part of it.

segments.speaker: Senator Panfilo Lacson
segments.text: But they are part of the municipal, provincial,

segments.speaker: Senator Panfilo Lacson
segments.text: during the deliberation of the local government plans.

segments.speaker: DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
Senator Panfilo Lacson
segments.text: they can send their own representatives, di ba?

segments.speaker: Senator Panfilo Lacson
segments.text: ba't kami makipag-debate sa inyo dyan?

segments.speaker: DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
Senator Panfilo Lacson
segments.text: Eh, pagdating sa amin, kami yung hari.

segments.speaker: DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
Senator Panfilo Lacson
segments.text: laging puno yung hallway namin dito.

segments.speaker: Senator Panfilo Lacson
segments.text: May mga folders lahat yung mga local government executives.

segments.speaker: Senator Panfilo Lacson
segments.text: kung tataasan natin yung percentage share

segments.speaker: Senator Panfilo Lacson
segments.text: Kasi kung i-adapt sa national budget yung kanilang...

segments.speaker: Senator Panfilo Lacson
segments.text: di ba yung local government officials?

segments.speaker: DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
Senator Panfilo Lacson
segments.text: Hindi alam naman ng senators and congressmen

segments.speaker: Senator Panfilo Lacson
segments.text: We don't even coordinate or consult with the local government officials and the agencies that will implement the PAPs.

segments.speaker: Senator Panfilo Lacson
segments.text: So I think it's about time.

segments.speaker: Senator Panfilo Lacson
segments.text: Kasi, you know, I'm happy na during the campaign, the President issued EO82, diba?

segments.speaker: Senator Panfilo Lacson
segments.text: Ito yung enhancing the Regional Development Council.

segments.speaker: Senator Panfilo Lacson
segments.text: In fact, when he was joining our campaign, laging meron siyang extra activity with the RDC.

segments.speaker: Senator Panfilo Lacson
segments.text: Laging kasama sa ano yan, sa kanyang itinerary.

segments.speaker: Senator Panfilo Lacson
segments.text: Kaya misa nadidelay yung rally because nanggagaling pa siya sa RDC meetings.

segments.speaker: Senator Panfilo Lacson
segments.text: So, but how can we translate that into actual practice?

segments.speaker: Senator Panfilo Lacson
segments.text: How can you fight batasan and how can you fight?

segments.speaker: DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
segments.text: No, this is the Senate building.

segments.speaker: DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
segments.text: Sir, I think the new policy of enhancing the local government support fund has helped a great deal

segments.speaker: DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
segments.text: with the equalization of opportunities for the local government units.

segments.speaker: DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
segments.text: Under the auspices of the current President, he's increased it tenfold, I think,

segments.speaker: DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
segments.text: It was less than 6 billion in the previous budget.

segments.speaker: DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
segments.text: And it's helped a great deal.

segments.speaker: DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
segments.text: Local government units and they find great comfort that finally Malacanang is listening to the plight of the local government units.

segments.speaker: DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
segments.text: So, I think enhancing the LGSF is one of the great equalizing factors in order for these projects and to be aligned with the national project, sir.

segments.speaker: Senator Panfilo Lacson
segments.text: Nag-spike ito dramatically sa 57.87 billion in 2026.

segments.speaker: Senator Panfilo Lacson
segments.text: So, tumataas talaga yung local government support fund.

segments.speaker: DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
segments.text: In 2025, sir, the 22.99 billion LGSF was not given to the local governments, but rather disbursed by congressmen and senators.

segments.speaker: DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
segments.text: Unlike today, sir, the 58 billion goes directly to the local government.

segments.speaker: DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
segments.text: So, there is now a greater connection between the local government units and the national governments.

segments.speaker: Senator Panfilo Lacson
segments.text: Tanong ko lang, did you wrestle with the congressmen when you...

segments.speaker: DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
segments.text: No, sir, it was not an issue anymore.

segments.speaker: DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
segments.text: We finished last week, two weeks ago, and it was not an issue with them.

segments.speaker: Senator Panfilo Lacson
segments.text: I'm glad to hear that, Mr. Secretary.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: The reason why this budget hearings, it was started by our Senate President last year,

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: to prevent occurrence again of anomalous projects like the ghost projects and flood control,

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: we already require RDC approval, or at the very least provincial,

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: pero more of the RDC approval for all the projects.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: Kasi nangyayari, we do not want a repeat of what happened before

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: na basta maiproject lang kahit hindi kailangan.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: Hindi nga alam ng governor, hindi alam ng local government, nagkakaroon ng projects eh.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: So with that, we will now require RDC approval, Mr. Chair, kasi yun yung nangyayari noon.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: Kahit hindi alam ng LGU or provincia, nagkakaproject para alam na natin

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: pagkapirahan lang, hindi naman talaga kailangan.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: So now, RDC approval is as a requirement now for all the projects or yung pang nangihingi ng

segments.speaker: Senator Panfilo Lacson
segments.text: We are thinking of passing a legislation that the UHC...

segments.speaker: Senator Panfilo Lacson
segments.text: this is not enough at the local level, for the universal healthcare program.

segments.speaker: Senator Panfilo Lacson
segments.text: He is the author of the UHC.

segments.speaker: Senator Panfilo Lacson
segments.text: He is the one that sponsored it.

segments.speaker: Senator Panfilo Lacson
segments.text: The DOH fund, especially in hospitals, is already earmarked by the LGUs, just like the Calamity Fund, right? It has 5%.

segments.speaker: Senator Panfilo Lacson
segments.text: So that the national government will not know how to deploy the logistics or the support for the health programs of the LGUs.

segments.speaker: DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
segments.text: Sir, I think we should take caution to that, because not all local governments have the capacity to implement, to absorb the said amounts.

segments.speaker: DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
segments.text: As it is, the setup is that the universal health care plan goes to the government hospitals directly to support the program.

segments.speaker: DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
segments.text: Giving it directly to the LGUs might be counterproductive, because not all LGUs have the capacity to implement.

segments.speaker: Senator Panfilo Lacson
segments.text: So, thank you, Mr. Secretary, and thank you to the entire...

segments.speaker: Senator Panfilo Lacson
segments.text: Anyway, support staff, in case the Secretary needs to ask, you will also ask.

segments.speaker: Senator Panfilo Lacson
segments.text: But it looks like all the Secretaries know the answer, so you are not top yet.

segments.speaker: Senator Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: Mr. Chairman, actually, to be honest...

segments.speaker: Senator Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: To be honest about it, I'm not saying this because the Secretary is here, but I have a lot of respect for the Secretaries who, when it comes to the budget season, budget hearings, they are the ones who answer.

segments.speaker: Senator Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: It means that they know their budget.

segments.speaker: Senator Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: Because there are many Secretaries, oh, Yusek, answer this, oh, Asek, answer this, oh, this, Director, answer this.

segments.speaker: Senator Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: That's your budget, you should know what your budget contains.

segments.speaker: Senator Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: So, you should defend your budget, not Yusek, not Asek.

segments.speaker: Senator Sherwin "Win" T. Gatchalian
segments.text: So, I'm not saying this because I've been in Central JB, it sounds familiar.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: Likewise, I'm sorry, sir, bago mag-adjourn, siguro request ko lang kay Usec, no?

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: I'm now the Chair of the local government again, and sometimes we have some measures or bills that are being heard for local governments.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: Andami akong nakitang Usec na bago at Asec.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: Maybe you can send someone that will be designated, that can speak for the department.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: Kasi lately, napagalitan ko yung huli, director, pinadala ilang beses, hindi naman makasagot.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: So, I hope it doesn't happen again.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: Dati si Usec Rolando Puno, di ba?

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: Kaya nag-a-attend, nung Asec pa kayo.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: Nag-Usec ka, hindi na kita nakita.

segments.speaker: DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
segments.text: That was a mistake on my part, sir. And we will make sure to rectify.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: Siguro for legislative, ano lang, concerns, you may be send someone.

segments.speaker: DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: At sila, yung Usec Marlo Iringan, yung mga usual natin noon eh.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: Kaya yun ang naging [unclear]. Baka naman na-tempo lang itong dalawang director. Hindi makasagot eh, so sayang lang.

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: So, we send someone that will be designated for our legislative functions.

segments.speaker: DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
Senator Panfilo Lacson
segments.text: In the same vein, I'm now the Chairman of the Public Order Committee.

segments.speaker: Senator Panfilo Lacson
segments.text: The Firearms Amendment, about the Firearms, I will attend to that.

segments.speaker: Senator Panfilo Lacson
segments.text: I just need your draft of your legislative proposal.

segments.speaker: DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
Senator Panfilo Lacson
segments.text: So, with that, is there a motion to approve and submit to the plenary the budget of the DILG?

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: Yes, Mr. Chair, I move that the budget of the DILG and its attached agencies be submitted

segments.speaker: Senator Joseph Victor "JV" G. Ejercito
segments.text: to the plenary for discussion and for debates, further debates, Mr. Chair.

segments.speaker: DILG Secretary Juanito Victor C. Remulla
